# Catchments

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Which community team covers a suburb, every community team from A to Z, and team names that read alike.

## What is on the screen

1. Suburb lookup. Type a suburb or postcode. It names the team that covers it.
2. A to Z. Every community team. Narrow by health service, then open a team's own page.
3. Read alike. Team names that look similar, side by side, so you open the right one.
4. Back to Places. Choose Places to go back to every ward, ED and team.

## On a phone

- One list at a time. Suburb, A to Z, Read alike or Services. Choose one to read that list.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
